claims.claim: Media queries test characteristics of the user environment so that CSS can be applied conditionally.
The @media at-rule applies its contained rules when its media query is true.
A media query can include a media type and one or more media conditions, and comma-separated queries act as an OR list.
Width features can be written with min-/max- prefixes or modern range syntax such as width >= 48rem.
The prefers-reduced-motion media feature expresses whether a user has requested reduced non-essential motion.
The print media type can conditionally apply print-oriented CSS.
